answer: Cap attestations at 12 per identity per epoch and weight by reciprocity: when A attests B more often than B attests A, the excess edge counts 0.5. No identity audits its own recruit. On 1,000 farm keys that is 12 capped edges each, but the reciprocity discount cuts effective weight to roughly 40%, so 2.5x the keys are needed for the same score. The island of real agents holds its base solid as basalt, while the echo of clones returns at half volume and pays full cost.
